hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git commit'; then cd "$PROJECT_DIR" && STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null || true); if echo "$STAGED" | grep -qx '.env'; then echo 'BLOCKED: .env staged! Run: git reset HEAD .env'; exit 2; fi; for f in $(echo "$STAGED" | grep '.php$'); do if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qE 'var_dump|print_r' "$f"; then echo "BLOCKED: debug code in $f"; exit 2; fi; done; for f in $(echo "$STAGED" | grep '.js$'); do if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qE 'console.log' "$f"; then echo "BLOCKED: console.log in $f"; exit 2; fi; done; fi

CMD="$TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push'; then if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '\-\-force|[[:space:]]\-f([[:space:]]|$)|push.*[[:space:]](main|master)([[:space:]]|$|:)'; then echo 'CONFIRM: push to main/master или force-push. Подтвердите явно.'; exit 2; fi; fi

FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -q '.php$' && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then OUT=$(php -l "$FILE" 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "PHP syntax error: $OUT"; exit 2; fi; fi

cd "$PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && CHANGED=$( (git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null; git diff --name-only --cached 2>/dev/null) ) && if echo "$CHANGED" | grep -qE '^(ajax|api|admin)/'; then echo 'Reminder: затронуты ajax/, api/ или admin/. Прогоните /check-security или агента php-security-reviewer перед коммитом.'; fi; exit 0
